description: PRIMARY skill for clock-based session wakes via scheduleCallback. Use when the user asks for reminders, delays, or recurring checks inside the active conversation — "remind me in 5 minutes", "tomorrow at 9", "매일 아침 확인해줘", timers, and wall-clock recurrence bound to this chat. NEVER for process exit, build/test completion, kanban/ticket done, webhooks, or file-watcher completion — use call-me-back. Prefer this over global schedule for in-session time requests; escalate to schedule only for permanent app-wide cron.
